summary.result: The resulting optimal EBPN model for forecasting daily streamflow consists of three rainfall and four runoff data (Model34), and the best number of the hidden nodes were found to be 13.
summary.background: An artificial neural network model was developed to analyze and forecast daily steamflow flow a small watershed.
summary.method: The model adopts a gradient descent method where the momentum and adaptive learning rate concepts were employed to minimize local minima value problems and speed up the convergence of EBP method.
